--- Layer 1b: DEVICE-signed remote arm (a deliberate, reviewed trust-widening) ----------------\n162\t    def arm_by_device(self, request: dict, *, now: Optional[float] = None) -> Optional[Session]:\n163\t        \"\"\"Arm on a VERIFIED, owner-authorized DEVICE signature (SIGIL §remote-arm). Fail-closed at each step; a refusal is recorded, never armed.\"\"\"\n166\t        from ..governor.killswitch import KillSwitch\n167\t        from ..mesh import authorized_devices\n168\t        from ..reuse import verify_one\n169\t        now = time.time() if now is None else now\n170\t        # (1) kill-switch FIRST — an owner halt (incl. a phone panic) beats any arm.\n171\t        if KillSwitch(self.store).is_engaged():\n172\t            return self._refuse_arm(request, \"kill-switch engaged\")\n173\t        # (2) owner-minted device key + valid signature over the signed core (RP-APPROVAL-2: the\n174\t        #     authorized set is owner-signed only, so a merely-presented key is never trusted).\n175\t        if request.get(\"signal\") != ARM_REQUEST:\n176\t            return self._refuse_arm(request, \"not an arm request\")\n177\t        pub = request.get(\"pubkey\")\n178\t        authorized = authorized_devices(self.store, self._trusted())\n179\t        core = {k: request.get(k) for k in _ARM_CORE}\n180\t        try:                                            # verify_one RAISES on a malformed-length sig — treat as refusal\n181\t            sig_ok = bool(pub) and pub in authorized and verify_one(pub, arm_request_message(core), request.get(\"sig\", \"\"))\n182\t        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 — any crypto/decoding error is a fail-closed refusal, never a crash\n183\t            sig_ok = False\n184\t        if not sig_ok:\n185\t            return self._refuse_arm(request, \"unauthorized or invalid device signature\")\n186\t        # (3) freshness — bounds the replay window and rejects a stale captured request. Written\n187\t        #     fail-CLOSED for non-finite input: `nan > 30` is False, so a signed NaN ts would slip a\n188\t        #     `>`-style gate; require finite AND within-window explicitly.\n189\t        try:\n190\t            ts = float(request.get(\"ts\"))\n191\t        except (TypeError, ValueError):\n192\t            return self._refuse_arm(request, \"missing/invalid timestamp\")\n193\t        if not math.isfinite(ts) or not (abs(now - ts) <= ARM_FRESHNESS):\n194\t            return self._refuse_arm(request, \"stale or non-finite timestamp\")\n195\t        # (4) replay — this (device, nonce) must not have armed before (the append-only spine is witness).\n196\t        nonce = request.get(\"nonce\")\n197\t        for r in self.store.iter_records():\n198\t            p = r.payload\n199\t            if (p.get(\"signal\") == SESSION_ARMED and p.get(\"armed_by\") == \"device\"\n200\t                    and p.get(\"device_pubkey\") == pub and p.get(\"nonce\") == nonce):\n201\t                return self._refuse_arm(request, \"replayed arm nonce\")\n202\t        # (5) single live session — a device arm NEVER displaces an existing/owner session.\n203\t        if self.session is not None and self.session.live and not self.session.expired(now):\n204\t            return self._refuse_arm(request, \"a gesture session is already live\")\n205\t        # (6) TTL clamp — shorter than a local owner arm; This is the wiring that makes the trust-widening reachable.\"\"\"\n27\t    if store is None:\n28\t        from ..spine.store import SpineStore\n29\t        store = SpineStore()\n30\t    if source is None:\n31\t        from ..perception.camera_stream import CameraStreamSource\n32\t        source = CameraStreamSource()\n33\t    if landmarker is None:\n34\t        from .landmark import OnnxHandLandmarker\n35\t        landmarker = OnnxHandLandmarker()\n36\t    # STRICT fail-closed egress gate (Phase 9 W2-H): this loop injects HID off a live camera stream,\n37\t    # so it refuses UNLESS the landmarker is EXPLICITLY on-box (`egresses is False`) — stricter than\n38\t    # perceive's default-safe `getattr(..., \"egresses\", False)` form, because an unset/unknown flag\n39\t    # here would mean streaming owner PIXELS off-box while driving the pointer. When False, the caller's gate is\n59\t        # already armed (a LOCAL owner-armed session) and we consume it without a second arm.\n60\t    n = 0\n61\t    _attempted: set = set()\n62\t    try:\n63\t        for frame in source.frames():\n64\t            if device_arm and (g.session is None or not g.session.live):\n65\t                from .session import pending_device_arms    # REMOTE-arm: consume recorded arm requests\n66\t                for req in pending_device_arms(store, trusted_pubkey):   # oldest-first — a newer stale one\n67\t                    _key = (req.get(\"pubkey\"), req.get(\"nonce\"))         # can't shadow an older valid one\n68\t                    if _key in _attempted:                  # attempt each recorded request ONCE (no per-frame\n69\t                        continue                            # refusal spam from a stale/refused request)\n70\t                    _attempted.add(_key)\n71\t                    if g.arm_by_device(req) is not None:    # re-verifies fully; stop once one arms\n72\t                        break\n73\t            reading = classifier.classify(landmarker.detect(frame))\n74\t            intent = pipe.on_frame(reading)\n75\t            if intent is not None:\n76\t                g.handle(intent)\n77\t            n += 1\n78\t            if max_frames is not None and n >= max_frames:\n79\t                break\n80\t    finally:\n81\t        g.disarm()\n82\t    return n\n83\t"}]},"uuid":"21bb9bb7-3348-45f7-9f3a-347dad81c8b5","timestamp":"2026-07-19T09:12:46.206Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"7bce3f97-f89f-421b-843b-cac5cf90f923","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

The `ScriptedLandmarker` double (in `components.py`) drives every test.\"\"\"\n7\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n8\t\n9\tfrom pathlib import Path\n10\tfrom typing import List, Optional\n11\t\n12\tfrom ..config import SIGIL_HOME\n13\tfrom .types import Hand\n14\t\n15\t_MODEL = SIGIL_HOME / \"models\" / \"hand_landmark.onnx\"\n16\t\n17\t\n18\tclass OnnxHandLandmarker:\n19\t    egresses = False\n20\t\n21\t    def __init__(self, model_path: Optional[str] = None):\n22\t        self.model_path = Path(model_path) if model_path else _MODEL\n23\t        self._session = None\n24\t\n25\t    def _sess(self):\n26\t        if self._session is None:\n27\t            try:\n28\t                import onnxruntime as ort\n29\t                if not self.model_path.exists():\n30\t                    return None\n31\t                self._session = ort.InferenceSession(str(self.model_path),\n32\t                                                     providers=ort.get_available_providers())\n33\t            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 — no runtime/model → honest empty\n34\t                return None\n35\t        return self._session\n36\t\n37\t    def detect(self, image) -> List[Hand]:\n38\t        sess = self._sess()\n39\t        if sess is None or image is None:\n40\t            return []\n41\t        try:\n42\t            import numpy as np\n43\t            # NOTE: a wired model preprocesses (resize/normalize) + parses the palm-ROI → 21-kp output.\n44\t            # Kept deliberately minimal here: with no bundled .onnx this path returns [] (honest gap),\n45\t            # exactly like capture.grab_camera returning None rather than a fabricated frame.\n46\t            _ = np  # preprocessing lives here in a bundled build\n47\t            return []\n48\t        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001\n49\t            return []\n50\t"}]},"uuid":"f2e1c8bc-c03b-4ccd-8b1e-0cbd8bb82449","timestamp":"2026-07-19T09:12:46.686Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"9653ba05-06f2-4e77-9884-298c38f20272","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

{"parentUuid":"c5f034a2-2f32-42d7-8033-4de05365efd2","isSidechain":true,"promptId":"3f8d7a84-2083-490c-adb3-be5a0da7c099","agentId":"a76410677129e1501","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01Vd8aEYevqJ2EVz26mwVgij","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t\"\"\"Web engine (Phase 8, WS-G G-iii) — HTTP-only. `HttpEngine` reuses the SSRF-gated, IP-pinned,\n2\tcorrelatable-UA `sources.fetch_raw` for the read path and pins the SAME vetted IP for the write path\n3\t(so the bytes that were block-checked/hashed and the endpoint that receives credentials are one\n4\taddress — no DNS-rebinding split). `detect_block` is a BEST-EFFORT flag for a CAPTCHA / 403 / 429 /\n5\tCF-challenge; a DETECTED block STOPS + is surfaced as a positive control (it is not a guarantee that\n6\tevery anti-automation page is recognised — a missed soft-block only ever means the actor proceeds as\n7\tapproved, never that a block is defeated). There is deliberately NO headless-browser / JS-render path\n8\tin this actor: \"use a browser to beat a block\" is unreachable because the capability does not exist.\n9\t`FakeEngine` is the deterministic double + call spy for tests.\"\"\"\n10\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n11\t\n12\timport re\n13\tfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n14\tfrom typing import Optional, Protocol, runtime_checkable\n15\t\n16\t_BLOCK = re.compile(r\"recaptcha|hcaptcha|turnstile|cf-chl|just a moment|attention required|\\bcaptcha\\b\", re.I)\n17\t\n18\t\n19\t@dataclass\n20\tclass PageView:\n21\t    ok: bool\n22\t    status: int\n23\t    html: str\n24\t    url: str\n25\t    resolved_ip: str = \"\"    # the vetted IP the read used — threaded into act() to bind the write to it\n26\t\n27\t\n28\t@runtime_checkable\n29\tclass WebEngine(Protocol):\n30\t    egresses: bool\n31\t    def fetch(self, url: str) -> PageView: ...\n32\t    def act(self, step: dict, resolved: dict, *, pinned_ip: Optional[str] = None) -> dict: ...\n33\t\n34\t\n35\tdef detect_block(status: int, html: str) -> Optional[str]:\n36\t    \"\"\"A best-effort block signal (STOP + surface as a positive control — never defeated). Runs BEFORE\n37\t    any action. Keys on 403/429 and a fixed anti-automation keyword set; it can MISS a soft-block.\"\"\"\n38\t    if status in (403, 429):\n39\t        return f\"http-{status}\"\n40\t    if _BLOCK.search(html or \"\"):\n41\t        return \"captcha/anti-automation\"\n42\t    return None\n43\t\n44\t\n45\tclass HttpEngine:\n46\t    egresses = True\n47\t\n48\t    def fetch(self, url: str) -> PageView:\n49\t        from .sources import fetch_raw\n50\t        r = fetch_raw(url)\n51\t        return PageView(r.ok, r.status, r.raw, url, resolved_ip=r.resolved_ip)\n52\t\n53\t    def act(self, step: dict, resolved: dict, *, pinned_ip: Optional[str] = None) -> dict:\n54\t        \"\"\"A simple static-form submit (urlencoded POST). Credentials arrive in `resolved` at the last\n55\t        instant and go ONLY into the POST body — never the URL, never logged/returned. The socket is\n56\t        pinned to `pinned_ip` when the caller supplies the IP its read already vetted (binding the write\n57\t        to the block-checked address); otherwise the IP is re-vetted here (fail-closed on private).\"\"\"\n58\t        import urllib.parse\n59\t        import urllib.request\n60\t        from urllib.parse import urlsplit\n61\t        from .sources import UA, _NoRedirect, _PinnedHTTPHandler, _PinnedHTTPSHandler, _vetted_ip\n62\t        url = step.get(\"url\", \"\")\n63\t        ip = pinned_ip or _vetted_ip(urlsplit(url).hostname or \"\")\n64\t        if ip is None:\n65\t            return {\"ok\": False, \"reason\": \"ssrf-refused\"}\n66\t        data = urllib.parse.urlencode(resolved).encode(\"utf-8\")\n67\t        opener = urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.ProxyHandler({}), _PinnedHTTPHandler(ip),\n68\t                                             _PinnedHTTPSHandler(ip), _NoRedirect)\n69\t        req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=data, method=\"POST\",\n70\t                                     headers={\"User-Agent\": UA, \"Content-Type\": \"application/x-www-form-urlencoded\"})\n71\t        try:\n72\t            with opener.open(req, timeout=20) as r:\n73\t                return {\"ok\": 200 <= getattr(r, \"status\", 200) < 400, \"status\": getattr(r, \"status\", 200)}\n74\t        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001\n75\t            return {\"ok\": False, \"reason\": f\"{type(e).__name__}\"}   # type name only — never the body/exception text\n76\t\n77\t\n78\tclass FakeEngine:\n79\t    \"\"\"Deterministic double + spy: `pages` = {url: (status, html)}; records every fetch/act (act records\n80\t    the field KEYS and the pinned IP only — never a value).\"\"\"\n81\t    egresses = True\n82\t\n83\t    def __init__(self, pages: Optional[dict] = None, *, resolved_ip: str = \"203.0.113.7\"):\n84\t        self.pages = pages or {}\n85\t        self.resolved_ip = resolved_ip\n86\t        self.calls: list = []\n87\t\n88\t    def fetch(self, url: str) -> PageView:\n89\t        self.calls.append((\"fetch\", url))\n90\t        st, html = self.pages.get(url, (404, \"\"))\n91\t        return PageView(200 <= st < 300, st, html, url, resolved_ip=self.resolved_ip)\n92\t\n93\t    def act(self, step: dict, resolved: dict, *, pinned_ip: Optional[str] = None) -> dict:\n94\t        self.calls.append((\"act\", step.get(\"url\"), sorted(resolved.keys()), pinned_ip))   # keys + IP only — never values\n95\t        return {\"ok\": True, \"status\": 200}\n96\t"}]},"uuid":"470cc342-05b1-4c1a-8cb9-77325ab8cdef","timestamp":"2026-07-19T09:12:46.889Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"c5f034a2-2f32-42d7-8033-4de05365efd2","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}

{"parentUuid":"73b2a5b2-02bc-45b8-885c-a6809cae0529","isSidechain":true,"promptId":"3f8d7a84-2083-490c-adb3-be5a0da7c099","agentId":"a76410677129e1501","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01Msb5osxRj9hfsoo8chQr2p","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t\"\"\"Qdrant vector index over spine records (SIGIL §5b).\n2\t\n3\tOne point per spine record (id = spine seq), payload carries provenance (`entry_hash`,\n4\t`seq`, kind, source, session, project, ts) so every retrieval is citable. Incremental:\n5\tonly embeds records above the last-indexed seq. (Chunking of long records = 0b refinement.)\n6\t\"\"\"\n7\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n8\t\n9\tfrom typing import Any\n10\t\n11\tfrom ..config import EMBED_DIM, QDRANT_COLLECTION, QDRANT_PATH, QDRANT_URL\n12\tfrom ..spine.store import SpineStore\n13\tfrom .embed import embed, embed_one\n14\t\n15\t# bge-small cosine is compressed: genuinely in-corpus ~0.72-0.78, absent topics ~0.55-0.62.\n16\t# GROUNDED = a top hit is a real match; below it, memory has nothing strongly relevant.\n17\tGROUNDED_SCORE = 0.66\n18\tMIN_SCORE = 0.55  # individual results below this are dropped as noise\n19\t\n20\t_MAX_CHARS = 1600  # bound per-record text before embedding (model truncates ~512 tok anyway)\n21\t\n22\t# only recall-valuable kinds are embedded; the full record set still lives in the spine.\n23\t# raw tool_call/tool_result records (65% of a coding transcript, huge + low-recall-value)\n24\t# are NOT vector-indexed — they're reachable via episodic.range, not semantic search.\n25\tEMBEDDABLE_KINDS = frozenset({\"message\", \"decision\", \"commitment\", \"document\", \"session\", \"brief\", \"commit\"})\n26\t\n27\t\n28\tclass VectorIndex:\n29\t    def __init__(self, collection: str = QDRANT_COLLECTION) -> None:\n30\t        from qdrant_client import QdrantClient\n31\t        self.collection = collection\n32\t        # local/embedded mode (file-backed, no server) unless a server URL is configured\n33\t        if QDRANT_URL:\n34\t            self.client = QdrantClient(url=QDRANT_URL)\n35\t        else:\n36\t            QDRANT_PATH.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n37\t            self.client = QdrantClient(path=str(QDRANT_PATH))\n38\t        self._ensure()\n39\t\n40\t    def _ensure(self) -> None:\n41\t        from qdrant_client.models import Distance, PayloadSchemaType, VectorParams\n42\t        names = [c.name for c in self.client.get_collections().collections]\n43\t        if self.collection not in names:\n44\t            self.client.create_collection(\n45\t                collection_name=self.collection,\n46\t                vectors_config=VectorParams(size=EMBED_DIM, distance=Distance.COSINE),\n47\t            )\n48\t        # a payload index on `seq` powers the durable cursor (OrderBy). Server mode enforces\n49\t        # it; local mode ignores it. Idempotent — created here so a MIGRATED collection (which\n50\t        # never ran index_spine) still gets the cursor. Must exist before last_indexed_seq().\n51\t        try:\n52\t            self.client.create_payload_index(self.collection, \"seq\", PayloadSchemaType.INTEGER)\n53\t        except Exception:\n54\t            pass\n55\t\n56\t    def reset(self) -> None:\n57\t        \"\"\"Drop + recreate the collection (used when the embed policy changes).\"\"\"\n58\t        try:\n59\t            self.client.delete_collection(self.collection)\n60\t        except Exception:\n61\t            pass\n62\t        self._ensure()\n63\t\n64\t    def count(self) -> int:\n65\t        return self.client.count(self.collection, exact=True).count\n66\t\n67\t    def last_indexed_seq(self) -> int:\n68\t        \"\"\"Highest spine seq already indexed (durable cursor), or -1 if empty.\"\"\"\n69\t        from qdrant_client.models import OrderBy\n70\t        try:\n71\t            pts, _ = self.client.scroll(self.collection, limit=1, with_payload=True,\n72\t                                        order_by=OrderBy(key=\"seq\", direction=\"desc\"))\n73\t            return int(pts[0].payload[\"seq\"]) if pts else -1\n74\t        except Exception:\n75\t            # order_by needs a payload index; fall back to count-based cursor is unsafe → -1\n76\t            return -1\n77\t\n78\t    def index_spine(self, store: SpineStore, *, since_seq: int = -1, batch: int = 256) -> int:\n79\t        from qdrant_client.models import PointStruct\n80\t        buf: list[Any] = []\n81\t        total = 0\n82\t\n83\t        def flush(records):\n84\t            vecs = embed([r.text()[:_MAX_CHARS] for r in records])\n85\t            points = [\n86\t                PointStruct(id=r.seq, vector=v, payload={\n87\t                    \"seq\": r.seq, \"kind\": r.kind, \"source\": r.source, \"actor\": r.actor,\n88\t                    \"session_id\": (r.payload or {}).get(\"session_id\"),\n89\t                    \"project\": (r.payload or {}).get(\"project\"),\n90\t                    \"ts\": r.ts, \"entry_hash\": r.entry_hash,\n91\t                    \"text\": r.text()[:1200],\n92\t                })\n93\t                for r, v in zip(records, vecs)\n94\t            ]\n95\t            self.client.upsert(self.collection, points=points)\n96\t            return len(points)\n97\t\n98\t        for r in store.iter_records(since_seq=since_seq):\n99\t            if r.kind not in EMBEDDABLE_KINDS or not r.text().strip():\n100\t                continue\n101\t            buf.append(r)\n102\t            if len(buf) >= batch:\n103\t                total += flush(buf)\n104\t                buf = []\n105\t        if buf:\n106\t            total += flush(buf)\n107\t        # a payload index on seq enables the durable cursor\n108\t        try:\n109\t            from qdrant_client.models import PayloadSchemaType\n110\t            self.client.create_payload_index(self.collection, \"seq\", PayloadSchemaType.INTEGER)\n111\t        except Exception:\n112\t            pass\n113\t        return total\n114\t\n115\t    def search(self, query: str, k: int = 8, project: str | None = None) -> list[dict]:\n116\t        from qdrant_client.models import FieldCondition, Filter, MatchValue\n117\t        flt = None\n118\t        if project:\n119\t            flt = Filter(must=[FieldCondition(key=\"project\", match=MatchValue(value=project))])\n120\t        qv = embed_one(query)\n121\t        res = self.client.query_points(self.collection, query=qv, limit=k,\n122\t                                       with_payload=True, query_filter=flt).points\n123\t        return [{\"score\": float(p.score), **(p.payload or {})} for p in res if float(p.score) >= MIN_SCORE]\n124\t\n125\t    def grounded(self, query: str, k: int = 8, project: str | None = None) -> tuple[list[dict], bool]:\n126\t        \"\"\"Search + a grounding verdict: (results, is_grounded). is_grounded is False when\n127\t        the best hit is below GROUNDED_SCORE — i.e. memory has nothing strongly relevant\n128\t        (prove-don't-guess: the caller must then decline to answer, not fabricate).\"\"\"\n129\t        hits = self.search(query, k=k, project=project)\n130\t        is_grounded = bool(hits) and hits[0][\"score\"] >= GROUNDED_SCORE\n131\t        return hits, is_grounded\n132\t"}]},"uuid":"ba89317d-81f0-4d73-a9e0-16c5b90ca819","timestamp":"2026-07-19T09:13:01.373Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"73b2a5b2-02bc-45b8-885c-a6809cae0529","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}
